svg.title: FIG-06 当前Core请求状态与借用 FIG-06 Current Core request and borrow states
svg.desc: READY：无 provider 借用 READY: no provider borrow; SETTLED：provider 最终访问后发布 SETTLED: published after final provider access; provider 借用保持 provider borrow remains valid; QUEUED; ACTIVE; DRAINING; QUARANTINED：责任保留 QUARANTINED: storage and responsibility retained; fresh initialize; REJECTED / 无借用 prepare：无残留引用或效果 REJECTED / unborrowed prepare: no retained refs; 适配器 ACCEPTED adapter ACCEPTED; 直接 provider ACCEPTED direct provider ACCEPTED; 执行推进 executor progress; 取消 / 停机推进 cancel / shutdown progress; 完成 / cancel / deadline completion / cancel / deadline; 不能安全排空 safe drain not established; 排空失败 drain failure; 队列等引用已排空 queue and related references drained; 全部必要引用已排空 all necessary references drained; 排空后 release 发布 drain then release-publish; 仅实际恢复和排空证明成立 only after proven recovery and drain; 消费结果和观察者退出后 prepare consume and join observers, then prepare
